sources.title: Nonidentifiability in model calibration and implications for medical decision making
sources.bounded_use: Different parameter values must induce different observable distributions for identifiability; observationally identical distributions cannot distinguish the hidden parameter.

sources.title: MIT 6.441 Information Theory, Chapter 2: Mutual Information
